h: Nine people reportedly arrested in Nigeria in a US-linked cybercrime probe, with 53 devices seized
p: Nine suspects have reportedly been detained in Nigeria over an international cybercrime investigation said to involve US agents. Dozens of phones and computers were reportedly taken for examination. The suspects are said to have targeted victims in the United States.
more: The 53 seized devices are said to be undergoing forensic checks.
No formal charges have been publicly confirmed yet.
